name: Camille Dulpher
source:
Camille Dulpher is the daughter of the famous husband and wife R&B duo Sweet Sounds (of Dulpher) that blessed the air waves with songs such as: "Is That a Rocket in Your Pocket?" and "The Rain Doesn't Make Me Wet." Her parents still tour the larger cities in the U.S. and do quite well. A "best-of" album is planned: "15 Songs That Will Make You Blush." Camille is a stapel at the Red Hot Kitten. She is calm, modest, and charming.

[Edited from in-game description]
